sn14.18:1.9: atītampi bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu …pe…
sn14.18:1.10: anāgatampi bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandissanti samenti …pe…
sn14.18:2.1: etarahipi bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
sn14.18:2.3: ahirikā ahirikehi saddhiṃ …pe… duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ …pe…
sn14.18:2.6: paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti. (paṭhamattikaṃ) dhātusova bhikkhave, sattā saṃsandanti samenti: assaddhā assaddhehi …pe… anottāpino anottāpīhi …pe… duppaññā duppaññehi …pe… saddhā saddhehi …pe… ottāpino ottāpīhi …pe… paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti. atītampi bhikkhave addhānaṃ …pe… anāgatampi bhikkhave addhānaṃ …pe… etarahipi bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ [dhātusova sattā saṃsandanti] samenti: [assaddhaṃ assaddhehi …pe… anottāpino anottāpīhi …pe… duppaññā duppaññehi …pe… saddhā saddhehi …pe… ottāpino ottāpīhi …pe… paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti, samenti.] (dutiyattikaṃ)
sn14.18:3.7: paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti. atītampi
sn14.18:4.2: anāgatampi bhikkhave addhānaṃ …pe… etarahipi bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ …pe… [assaddhaṃ assaddhehi …pe… appassutā appassutehi …pe… duppaññā duppaññehi …pe… saddhā saddhehi …pe… bahussutā bahussutehi …pe… paññavanete paññavanetehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti] samenti.
sn14.18:5.6: āraddhaviriyā āraddhaviriyehi …pe… paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti. atītampi bhikkhave addhānaṃ …pe… anāgatampi bhikkhave addhānaṃ …pe… etarahipi bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ …pe… [assaddhā …pe… kusītā …pe… duppaññā …pe… saddhā …pe… āraddhaviriyā …pe… paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti. ] (catutthattikaṃ)
